title: Add a service charge
text: Create a service charge, then enable it for the products that use it.
steps: Go to Settings > Charges & Discounts.
Open the Service Charges tab.
Click Add Charge. Enter a Rate. Click Create Charge then Click Save.
Go to Products > Product List and open the product.
Under Tax & Discounts > Additional charges, turn on Service Charge, then save the product.
keywords: Paano mag add ng service charge
Paano mag add ng service fee

title: Add a discount type
text: Create a named discount, such as Employee Discount, with a value and tax setting.
steps: Click Settings > Charges & Discounts.
Open the Discounts tab.
Click Add Discount. Enter a name and choose Percentage or Fixed Amount.
Choose the tax setting: Standard, Tax-Exempt, or Tax-Adjusted.
Click Save. Assign the discount as a customer's Customer Type, or let the cashier choose it at the register.
Note: The default discount on each customer type is system-mandated and cannot be changed.

title: Set up government discounts
text: Senior Citizen, PWD, Solo Parent, and other government discounts are built in. Their rate and tax rule follow your business setup.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings, then Charges & Discounts.
Open the Discounts tab to see them.
Their rate and VAT rule come from your country, BIR, and VAT status under Business Details.
Click Sidebar > Customers. Edit the customer and set the Customer Type. The cashier then applies it by itself.
Note: The default discount on each customer type is system-mandated and cannot be changed.

title: Limit discounts the cashier can give
text: Set the maximum discount a cashier can give. Larger discounts can require manager approval.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings > Cashier Settings.
Find the Discounts section.
Set Default Discount Type to Percent or Fixed Amount.
Set the Discount Limit. Turn on manager approval for discounts above this limit.
Click Save.

title: Charge a fee for card or e-wallet payments
text: A fee tied to how the customer pays is set on the payment method, not here.
steps: Click Sidebar > Payment Methods.
Double-click the card or e-wallet method.
Set Payment Charge as a fixed amount or a percent.
Click Save.

title: The Charges page
text: The Charges page shows service charges, loyalty points, and discount types in one place.
steps: Click Sidebar > Settings.
To edit service charges or discounts, go to Settings > Charges & Discounts.
To edit loyalty points, go to Settings > Loyalty Points.

title: Edit a service charge
text: Change the rate of an existing service charge from the Service Charges tab.
steps: Go to Settings > Charges & Discounts.
Open the Service Charges tab.
Select the service charge you want to change.
Update the Rate, then click Save.
